Color identity: BR | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 10 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite looting; Near-infinite +1/+1 counters on a creature; Near-infinite creature ETB; Infinite draw triggers; Near-infinite creature LTB; Near-infinite death triggers; Near-infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Infinite self-discard triggers
Requires: Persist Creature (battlefield)
Start: Olivia, Mobilized for War (battlefield); Harvester of Souls (battlefield); Carrion Feeder (battlefield)
Prerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
Steps: Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the persist creature.
  When the persist creature dies, it and Harvester of Souls trigger.
  Resolve the Harvester of Souls trigger, causing you to draw a card.
  Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
  When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
  Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
  Repeat.

Color identity: BR | Bracket: 4+ (Ruthless) | Popularity: 120 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {1}{B}{R}{R}{R} plus {1} each subsequent turn
Produces: Infinite turns; Lock
Start: Magar of the Magic Strings (battlefield); Sundial of the Infinite (battlefield); Last Chance (hand)
Prerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Steps: Cast Last Chance by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and to lose the game at the beginning of that turn's end step.
  Activate Magar by paying {1}{B}{R}, noting Last Chance and putting it face down on the battlefield as a 3/3 creature.
  During your next turn, deal combat damage to an opponent using the face down creature that has Last Chance noted.
  The creature triggers, casting a copy of Last Chance without paying its mana cost. Resolve the copy, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and to lose the game at the beginning of that turn's end step.
  Activate Sundial of the Infinite by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to end the turn. This will prevent the Last Chance trigger from causing you to lose the game.
  Repeat from step 3.
